name.zh-Hant: 伊瓜蘇國家公園（伊瓜蘇瀑布）
name.zh-Hans: 伊瓜苏国家公园（伊瓜苏瀑布）

airspace.zh: 在巴西飛無人機，須先在民航局ANAC的SISANT系統登記，並透過空域管制機關DECEA的SARPAS系統申請飛行；伊瓜蘇國家公園由聯邦機構ICMBio管理，飛行前也應向公園確認。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: In Brazil a drone must be registered with the civil aviation agency ANAC (SISANT) and flights requested from the airspace authority DECEA through SARPAS; Iguaçu National Park is run by the federal agency ICMBio, so check with the park too. Check the current rules before any real flight.

throat.note: Largest fall, on the border (S 25°41.750 W 54°26.165)

park.note: Inside the park (World Heritage site centre)

tripoint.note: Confluence of the Iguazu and Paraná (S 25°35.678 W 54°35.442)

tagline.zh-Hant: 1541年的第一筆紀錄、航空先驅的呼籲、兩國的國家公園，與伊泰普水壩
tagline.en: A first record in 1541, an aviator's plea, two national parks and the Itaipu Dam

zh: 伊瓜蘇瀑布位在巴西與阿根廷的邊界上，
河的這一側，是巴西的伊瓜蘇國家公園。
en: Iguazu Falls lie on the border of Brazil and Argentina;
this bank of the river is Brazil's Iguaçu National Park.

zh: 1541年，西班牙探險家卡貝薩・德・巴卡，
留下了歐洲人對這座瀑布最早的紀錄。
en: In 1541 the Spanish explorer Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca
left the first European record of the falls.

zh: 1876年，工程師雷博薩斯在書中呼籲保護瀑布；
那時，世界第一座國家公園黃石，才成立四年。
en: In 1876 the engineer André Rebouças called for the falls to be protected;
Yellowstone, the first national park, was then only four years old.

zh: 1916年4月，航空先驅桑托斯－杜蒙來到瀑布，
他說，這樣的奇景不能只屬於一個人。
en: In April 1916 the aviation pioneer Alberto Santos-Dumont came to the falls;
such wonders, he said, could not belong to one individual.

zh: 那時，這片土地還是私人所有；
不久之後，巴拉那州把它收歸公有。
en: The land was then privately owned;
soon afterwards the state of Paraná took it into public hands.

zh: 對岸的阿根廷，在1934年設立伊瓜蘇國家公園；
巴西這一側，在1939年1月10日以聯邦命令設立。
en: Across the river Argentina set up its Iguazú National Park in 1934;
Brazil created its park by federal decree on 10 January 1939.

zh: 巴西的國家公園面積約十八萬五千公頃，
和阿根廷的公園相連，合起來約二十六萬公頃。
en: Brazil's park covers about 185,000 hectares;
joined to Argentina's, the two protect some 260,000.

zh: 1984年，阿根廷的公園列入世界遺產；
1986年，巴西的公園也列入名錄。
en: In 1984 Argentina's park became World Heritage;
Brazil's park followed in 1986.

zh: 巴西這一側曾被列入瀕危世界遺產名單。
en: From 1999 to 2001
the Brazilian park was on the list of World Heritage in Danger.

zh: 1973年4月26日，巴西與巴拉圭簽訂伊泰普條約，
要在巴拉那河上合建一座水壩。
en: On 26 April 1973 Brazil and Paraguay signed the Itaipu Treaty
to build a dam together on the Paraná.

zh: 1984年5月5日，第一部機組開始發電；
二十部機組，總容量一千四百萬瓩。
en: On 5 May 1984 its first generating unit started;
its 20 units give it 14 gigawatts.

zh: 1982年10月，水庫開始蓄水，
上游的瓜伊拉瀑布，從此沒入水中。
en: In October 1982 the reservoir began to fill,
and the Guaíra Falls upstream disappeared beneath it.

zh: 伊瓜蘇河在這裡匯入巴拉那河，
巴西、阿根廷與巴拉圭，三國在此交會。
en: Here the Iguazu flows into the Paraná,
where Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay meet.

zh: 三國各在自己的河岸立了一座方尖碑，
漆上國旗的顏色，從每一座都看得到另外兩國。
en: Each country has an obelisk on its own bank, painted in its national colours;
from each one all three countries are in view.

zh: 從探險家的紀錄，到兩國的國家公園，
這道大水，一直由邊界兩邊共同守護。
en: From an explorer's record to two national parks,
this great water has been looked after from both sides of the border.

title.en: The Name and Legend of the Great Water

tagline.zh-Hant: 瓜拉尼語的地名、戀人的傳說、電影裡的瀑布，與三國交界的邊城
tagline.en: A Guarani name, a lovers' legend, falls in films, and border towns at the Triple Frontier

zh: 「伊瓜蘇」的名字，來自瓜拉尼語或圖皮語：
「y」是水，「ûasú」是大，合起來就是「大水」。
en: "Iguazu" comes from Guarani or Tupi:
y means water and ûasú means big — "big water".

zh: 傳說，一位神祇看上了美麗的少女娜依琵，
她卻和心愛的塔羅巴，划著獨木舟逃走。
en: Legend says a god wanted the beautiful Naipí,
but she fled in a canoe with her mortal lover, Tarobá.

zh: 神祇一怒之下，把河流劈開，
這對戀人，從此永遠墜落。
en: In his anger the god sliced the river apart,
condemning the lovers to an eternal fall.

zh: 桑托斯－杜蒙的紀念像，1979年立在瀑布旁，
紀念這位「航空之父」為設立公園奔走。
en: A statue of Santos-Dumont was raised beside the falls in 1979,
honouring the "Father of Aviation" who worked for the park.

zh: 據說，美國第一夫人愛蓮娜・羅斯福看到這裡，
脫口而出：「可憐的尼加拉！」
en: Eleanor Roosevelt, it is said, took one look
and exclaimed, "Poor Niagara!"

zh: 2014年，巴西這一側的國家公園，
接待了一百五十五萬多名遊客。
en: In 2014 Brazil's park
welcomed more than 1.55 million visitors.

zh: 在阿根廷那一側，雨林生態小火車，
把遊客載到一個叫做「咽喉」的車站。
en: On the Argentine side the Rainforest Ecological Train
carries visitors to a station named Garganta — "Throat".

zh: 1986年的電影《教會》，就在這裡取景；
後來《007：太空城》與《印第安納瓊斯》也來過。
en: The 1986 film The Mission was shot here;
Moonraker and Indiana Jones came too.

zh: 2018年的電影《黑豹》，
也把這道瀑布放進了畫面。
en: In 2018 Black Panther
put these falls on the screen as well.

zh: 三國交界一帶住了大約九十五萬人，
是全世界人口最多的三國交界。
en: Some 950,000 people live around the Triple Frontier,
the most populous tripoint in the world.

zh: 巴拉圭的東方市最大，2018年約二十九萬九千人；
巴西的伊瓜蘇市，約二十五萬八千人。
en: Paraguay's Ciudad del Este is the largest, with 299,255 people in 2018;
Brazil's Foz do Iguaçu has about 258,000.

zh: 阿根廷的伊瓜蘇港最小，約八萬兩千人；
坦克雷多・內維斯橋，把它和巴西連在一起。
en: Argentina's Puerto Iguazú is the smallest, at about 82,000;
the Tancredo Neves Bridge links it to Brazil.

zh: 這裡也住著大約三萬名阿拉伯與其他亞洲移民，
讓三座邊城有了多元的面貌。
en: About 30,000 Arab and other Asian immigrants live here too,
giving the three border towns a varied face.

zh: 「伊泰普」在瓜拉尼語裡，是「會發聲的石頭」，
名字來自工地附近原本的一座小島。
en: Itaipu means "the sounding stone" in Guarani,
after an island that once stood near the building site.

zh: 瓜拉尼語的地名、戀人的傳說與三國的邊城，
都圍繞著這道大水而生。
en: Guarani names, a lovers' legend and three border towns
have all grown up around this great water.

tagline.zh-Hant: 大西洋森林的內陸殘存、美洲豹與巨獺、終年的水霧，與起伏的水量
tagline.en: A remnant of the interior Atlantic Forest, jaguars and giant otters, year-round spray and a changing flow

zh: 伊瓜蘇國家公園約九成是亞熱帶雨林，
屬於大西洋森林的內陸部分。
en: About 90% of Iguaçu National Park is subtropical rainforest,
part of the interior Atlantic Forest.

zh: 這裡是巴拉那亞熱帶森林留存最大的保護區之一，
物種豐富，也有許多特有種。
en: It is one of the largest protected remnants of the Paraná subtropical forest,
rich in species and in plants and animals found nowhere else.

zh: 低處的林下，長著樹蕨、附生植物與藤本；
較高較濕的地方，有巴西松與阿薩伊棕櫚。
en: Lower down grow tree ferns, epiphytes and lianas;
higher, wetter ground holds Brazilian pine and assaí palms.

zh: 美洲豹、美洲獅、虎貓、長尾虎貓與細腰貓，
都生活在這片森林裡。
en: Jaguar, puma, ocelot, margay and jaguarundi
all live in this forest.

zh: 河邊有巨獺，林間有貘和大食蟻獸，
還有體型嬌小的侏儒短角鹿。
en: Giant otters live along the rivers, tapirs and giant anteaters in the woods,
together with the small pygmy brocket deer.

zh: 鳥類之中，有角鵰、黑額鳴冠雉，
還有橫斑虎鷺。
en: Among the birds are the harpy eagle, the black-fronted piping guan
and the fasciated tiger heron.

zh: 河裡有伊瓜蘇特有的大型鯰魚，
也有巴西人叫做「皮拉坎茹巴」的魚。
en: The river holds a large catfish of the Iguaçu
and the fish Brazilians call piracanjuba.

zh: 瀑布終年揚起水霧，
這片水雲，也塑造了四周的植物。
en: The falls raise a cloud of spray all year round,
and that cloud shapes the plants around them.

zh: 魔鬼咽喉接住了河水的一半左右，
它的水霧與彩虹，七公里外都看得見。
en: The Devil's Throat takes about half the river,
and its spray and rainbows can be seen more than 7 km away.

zh: 公園裡的佛羅里亞諾河流域，
是巴拉那州唯一完整保存的流域。
en: The Floriano River basin inside the park
is the only one in Paraná state preserved whole.

zh: 兩國的公園一起巡守、共同規劃，
也是三國生態廊道的一部分。
en: The two countries' parks are patrolled and planned together,
and form part of a tri-national corridor.

zh: 這裡全年溫暖多雨，伊瓜蘇市年雨量約一千八百七十公釐，
水量通常在十二月到二月最大。
en: It is warm and wet all year — about 1,870 mm of rain a year at Foz do Iguaçu —
and the water is usually highest from December to February.

zh: 2006年乾旱時，流量曾降到每秒三百立方公尺；
平均流量，大約是每秒一千七百五十立方公尺。
en: In the 2006 drought the flow fell to 300 cubic metres a second;
on average it is about 1,750.

zh: 2014年6月9日，流量創下每秒四萬五千七百立方公尺的紀錄，
是平均的二十多倍。
en: On 9 June 2014 it reached a record 45,700 cubic metres a second,
more than twenty times the average.

zh: 上游的水壩會人為調節河水的高低，
公園也面對農地擴張與盜獵的壓力。
en: Dams upstream regulate the river's level artificially,
and the park faces farming at its edges and poaching.

zh: 雨林、水霧與森林裡的動物，
都和這條大河一起活著。
en: Rainforest, spray and the animals of the forest
all live together with this great river.

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩千七百公尺的瀑布邊緣、U形的魔鬼咽喉、一億多年前的玄武岩，與後退的岩壁
tagline.en: A 2,700 m edge of falls, the U-shaped Devil's Throat, basalt over 100 million years old, and retreating rock

zh: 伊瓜蘇河發源於庫里奇巴附近，大部分流經巴西；
在這裡，它是阿根廷與巴西的界河。
en: The Iguazu rises near Curitiba and flows mostly through Brazil;
here it forms the border of Argentina and Brazil.

zh: 瀑布的邊緣長約兩千七百公尺，
依水量不同，分成一百五十到三百道瀑布。
en: The edge of the falls is about 2,700 metres long,
split into 150 to 300 separate falls depending on the water.

zh: 河水分兩級落下，各約三十五和四十公尺；
單一瀑布最高，約八十二公尺。
en: The water drops in two steps, of about 35 and 40 metres;
the tallest single fall is about 82 metres.

zh: 魔鬼咽喉是一道U形的深谷，
長約七百公尺，寬約一百五十公尺。
en: The Devil's Throat is a U-shaped chasm
about 700 metres long and 150 metres wide.

zh: 國界正好從魔鬼咽喉中間穿過，
一邊是巴西，一邊是阿根廷。
en: The border runs right through the Devil's Throat,
with Brazil on one side and Argentina on the other.

zh: 一億兩千五百萬到一億一千五百萬年前，
大量玄武岩熔岩，從地面的裂隙湧出。
en: Between 125 and 115 million years ago
vast basalt lavas poured from cracks in the ground.

zh: 熔岩覆蓋約一百二十萬平方公里，最厚達一千五百公尺，
是陸地上記錄到最大的玄武岩熔岩流。
en: They covered about 1.2 million km², up to 1,500 metres thick,
the largest basalt lava flow recorded on the continents.

zh: 這些岩層在南美洲叫做塞拉熱拉爾層，
和非洲西部的岩層相對應，見證了岡瓦納大陸的分裂。
en: In South America these rocks are called the Serra Geral Formation;
they match rocks in western Africa, witnesses of the break-up of Gondwana.

zh: 瀑布由三層玄武岩構成，
最上面八到十公尺，是非常堅硬的氣孔玄武岩。
en: The falls are made of three layers of basalt;
the top 8 to 10 metres are a very hard vesicular basalt.

zh: 河水不斷侵蝕岩壁，
瀑布每年大約向上游後退一點四到二點一公分。
en: The river keeps wearing at the rock,
and the falls retreat upstream by about 1.4 to 2.1 cm a year.

zh: 瀑布下方的峽谷又窄又深，
一路延伸到下游與巴拉那河相接的地方。
en: Below the falls a narrow, deep canyon
runs all the way down to the Paraná.

zh: 在瀑布下游大約二十公里處，
伊瓜蘇河匯入巴拉那河。
en: About 20 km below the falls
the Iguazu joins the Paraná.

zh: 沿巴拉那河往上游約十五公里，
就是高一百九十六公尺的伊泰普水壩。
en: Some 15 km up the Paraná
stands the 196-metre Itaipu Dam.

zh: 它的水庫面積約一千三百五十平方公里，
2016年發電一千零三十一億度，創下紀錄。
en: Its reservoir covers about 1,350 square kilometres;
in 2016 it generated a record 103.1 terawatt-hours.

zh: 和尼加拉瀑布相比，伊瓜蘇的落差更大，
平均流量則比尼加拉小。
en: Compared with Niagara, Iguazu drops further,
though its average flow is smaller.

zh: 古老的熔岩、後退的岩壁與兩國的界河，
一起造出了這道大水。
en: Ancient lava, retreating rock and a border river
together made this great water.
